sentences.en: Which of your parents do you take after in character?
sentences.zh: 你从父母哪边继承了性格？

sentences.en: The different character typologies are represented schematically in figure one.
sentences.zh: 图一中示意性地表示了不同的性格类型。

sentences.en: Few books of this character have come to my attention.
sentences.zh: 很少有这类风格的书引起我的注意。

senses.zh: 性格，品质；特色，特征；人物，角色；勇气，毅力；某种人，古怪有趣的人；（书写或印刷）符号，文字，字体；名誉，名声

mnemonic: 联想记忆：char+acter（看作actor，演员）→演员刻画人物性格，惟妙惟肖→性格
